message:
Partial refunds now come out right, and `npm test` passes (20 of 20).

The bug was in `src/payments/partial-refund.js`. `percent` is a number from 0 to 100, but the code multiplied the payment amount by it directly, so every refund came out 100 times too large. I changed it to `payment.amount * percent / 100`. I only touched that file, so the change stays inside `src/payments`.
